title: 第21章 凛风城第22章 游侠公会
slug: 请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条

雷恩的怒吼声如同惊雷。
周围那些幸存的冒险者们，原本还沉浸在获救的喜悦中，此刻听到雷恩的话，一个个脸上的表情从茫然变成了震惊，最后化作了滔天的愤怒。
维克多站在人群边缘，听着这番话，心中也是一片冰凉。
他想起了杰克，想起了那个红发青年死前惊恐的眼神。
“雷恩大人，这……这其中可能有误会……”商队领队冷汗直流，试图辩解。
“有没有误会，回到凛风城再说。”
雷恩转过身，对卡特团长说道：
“卡特团长，我正式向城主府提出调查申请。”
雷恩要求回到凛风城后，对金穗商会展开全面调查。很明显金穗商会携带了超过d级任务范畴的物品，但是在提交护卫申请时没有向协会提前进行说明。
“在此期间，金穗商会的所有货物、人员，全部扣押。若有反抗，格杀勿论！”
“如您所愿，执事大人。”
卡特团长面色严肃地点了点头，一挥手。
身后的狮鹫骑士们立刻上前，长枪平举，将金穗商会的所有人团团围住。
“大人物之间的博弈啊……”
维克多低声喃喃自语，转身混入了正在接受骑士团盘查的幸存冒险者队伍中。
这场充满了血腥与算计的旅途，终于要到终点了。
而凛风城，似乎比那边灰语森林，还要更加危险，也更加……有趣。
简单的盘查过后，就是打扫战场，处理尸体的环节了。维克多非常卖力地帮忙，不论是冒险者还是刺客的尸体几乎都摸了个边。
与之前在灰语森林中一样，人类好像很难爆出词条。这些人的实力远在老约翰之上，但是都无法取得词条。

再次印证了他的推断：想要从人类身上掠夺词条，强烈的不甘和执念是不可或缺的前置条件。
当所有的收尾工作完成后，维克多环顾四周。除了协会的直属卫队还保留了相对完整的建制外，这次随行的商队成员和其他冒险者，差不多只有两成的人活了下来。
“看样子，这位雷恩大人是打算把黑锅全都扣在金穗商会头上了。”维克托在心中暗自腹诽，“虽说那批刺客确实是冲着商会来的，但大部分的伤亡明显是那两个职业者造成的。”
此处离凛风城还有不少距离，刚刚大战结束，大家也没有体力重新赶路了。雷恩重新安排了营地的防务，卡特团长的狮鹫编队在最内围歇息。
按理来说，这会不可能再有不长眼的过来找事了。但是维克多还是使用林语同调进行了警戒。
……
次日正午，当巨大的白色城墙如同从地平线上升起的雪线般映入眼帘时，维克多终于松了一口气。
凛风城，一座建立在风口之上的钢铁要塞。
在狮鹫编队的护卫下，车队没有任何阻碍地通过了盘查森严的城门。刚一进入外城区，扑面而来的喧嚣与繁华便让习惯了黑石镇那股霉味儿的维克多感到一阵恍惚。
这里的街道是整齐的青石板铺就，每一块都严丝合缝，足以让马车平稳飞驰，而不像黑石镇那样全是混合着泥浆和不知名排泄物的烂泥路。
空气中飘荡着烤面包、香料和皮革的混合气味，而不是那种挥之不去的粪便与腐烂味道。
巨大的白色城墙依山而建，层层叠叠，宛如巨兽的獠牙，将整座城市包裹在安全的怀抱中。
“呼——”
天空中传来沉闷的震动声，那是狮鹫骑士团正在塔楼起降。巨大的双翼拍打空气，发出的轰鸣声震耳欲聋，每一次起落都仿佛在向所有人宣告着这座城市的武力与威严。
凛风城的冒险者协会分部，规模比黑石镇那个破酒馆改建的办事处大了不知多少倍。宏伟的穹顶大厅内，水晶吊灯洒下明亮的光辉，几十个办事窗口同时开放，依然排着长队。
车队刚一停稳，甚至还没来得及卸货，几名身穿协会制服的职员就面色凝重地迎了上来。
“雷恩执事，分会长请您立刻去顶层会议室。”
领头的一名执事低声说道，虽然用了“请”字，但语气中却带着不容置疑的紧迫感。他的目光扫过雷恩空荡荡的左肩甲和惨白的脸色，眼神中闪过一丝震惊，但很快被职业素养掩盖。
雷恩点了点头，没有废话。他那张棱角分明的脸上看不出喜怒，只是在转身离开前，深深地看了一眼不远处正被卫兵看管的金穗商会众人。
“看来是要去撕逼了。”

维克多站在角落里，默默看着雷恩被一大群人簇拥着离开。
协会大厅的气氛肉眼可见地紧张起来，周围的冒险者们都在窃窃私语，显然昨晚那场惊动了狮鹫骑士团的袭击已经传开了。

Ren's roar was like thunder.
The surviving adventurers around them were still immersed in the joy of being rescued. Now, upon hearing Ren's words, the expressions on their faces changed from confusion to shock, and finally turned into overwhelming anger.
Victor stood on the edge of the crowd, listening to these words, his heart felt cold.
He thought of Jack and the frightened look in the red-haired young man's eyes before he died.
"Lord Ren, there may be a misunderstanding..." The caravan leader was sweating coldly as he tried to defend himself.
"If there is any misunderstanding, let's talk about it back to Howling City."
Renn turned around and said to Captain Carter:
"Captain Carter, I formally submit an investigation application to the City Lord's Mansion."
Renne requested to launch a comprehensive investigation into the Golden Spike Chamber of Commerce after returning to Howling City. It was obvious that the Golden Harvest Chamber of Commerce carried items that exceeded the scope of D-level missions, but it did not explain it to the association in advance when submitting the escort application.
"During this period, all goods and personnel of the Golden Harvest Chamber of Commerce will be detained. If there is resistance, they will be killed without mercy!"
"As you wish, Lord Butler."
Captain Carter nodded solemnly and waved his hand.
The gryphon knights behind him immediately stepped forward, raising their spears, and surrounded everyone in the Golden Harvest Chamber of Commerce.
"The game between big shots..."
Victor murmured lowly, turned around and blended into the group of surviving adventurers who were being interrogated by the Knights.
This journey full of blood and calculations is finally coming to an end.
And Howling City seems to be more dangerous and more... interesting than the Gray Whispering Forest over there.
After a simple interrogation, it was time to clean the battlefield and dispose of the corpses. Victor worked very hard to help, almost touching the sides of the corpses of both adventurers and assassins.
Just like in the Gray Whisper Forest before, it seems difficult for humans to reveal the entries. The strength of these people is far greater than that of Old John, but they are unable to obtain the entry.
This once again confirmed his conclusion: if you want to plunder entries from humans, strong unwillingness and obsession are indispensable prerequisites.
When all the finishing touches were completed, Victor looked around. Except for the association's direct guard, which still retains a relatively intact structure, only about 20% of the caravan members and other adventurers who accompanied this time survived.
"It seems that Mr. Ren is planning to put all the blame on the Golden Spike Chamber of Commerce." Victor secretly cursed in his heart, "Although those assassins did come for the Chamber of Commerce, most of the casualties were obviously caused by those two professionals."
This place is still quite far away from Howling City. The war has just ended and everyone has no energy to start the journey again. Renne rearranged the defense of the camp, and Captain Carter's gryphon formation rested in the innermost perimeter.
Logically speaking, it would be impossible for someone without a short-sighted approach to come and cause trouble. But Victor still used Lin Yutong to warn.
…
At noon the next day, when the huge white city wall came into view like a line of snow rising from the horizon, Victor finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Howling City, a steel fortress built on the wind vent.
Under the escort of the griffin formation, the convoy passed through the heavily scrutinized city gate without any hindrance. As soon as he entered the outer city, the hustle and bustle that hit him made Victor, who was used to the musty smell of Blackstone Town, feel in a trance.
The streets here are paved with neat bluestones, and each piece fits tightly enough to allow a carriage to fly smoothly, unlike Blackstone Town, which is full of mud roads mixed with mud and unknown excrement.
Instead of the lingering smell of shit and rot, the air smelled of toast, spices and leather.
Huge white city walls are built against the mountains, layer upon layer, like the fangs of a giant beast, wrapping the entire city in a safe embrace.
"Huh——"
There was a dull vibration in the sky, it was the gryphonThe Knights are taking off and landing from the tower. The huge wings beat the air, and the roar was deafening. Every rise and fall seemed to declare the power and majesty of this city to everyone.
The Adventurer's Association branch in Howling City is many times larger than the office converted from a broken tavern in Blackstone Town. In the magnificent dome hall, crystal chandeliers cast bright light, dozens of service windows were open at the same time, and there was still a long queue.
As soon as the convoy came to a stop, before it even had time to unload, several employees wearing association uniforms came forward with solemn expressions.
"Deacon Ren, the branch president asks you to go to the top conference room immediately."
One of the leading deacons whispered. Although he used the word "please", there was an undeniable sense of urgency in his tone. His eyes swept across Renn's empty left shoulder armor and pale face. A trace of shock flashed in his eyes, but it was quickly covered up by his professionalism.
Ren nodded, no nonsense. There was no emotion or anger on his angular face, but before turning to leave, he took a deep look at the people of the Golden Harvest Chamber of Commerce who were being guarded by guards not far away.
"Looks like we're going to fight."
Victor stood in the corner, silently watching Ren being surrounded by a large group of people and leaving.
The atmosphere in the association hall became visibly tense, and the surrounding adventurers were whispering. Apparently, the attack that alarmed the Griffin Knights last night had spread.
